sponsored.t: Prohibits the use of adhesive-based rodent traps in state-owned or state-leased buildings
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the use of adhesive-based rodent traps in state-owned or state-leased buildings.

sponsored.t: Includes veterans in the definition of military status for purposes of unlawful discrimination
sponsored.sum: Includes veterans in the definition of military status to protect veterans from being unlawfully discriminated against.

sponsored.t: Relates to authorizing a five mile per hour speed limit for open streets in cities having a population in excess of one million
sponsored.sum: Relates to authorizing a five mile per hour speed limit for open streets in cities having a population in excess of one million.

sponsored.t: Relates to conditional release for eligible offenders who complete post-secondary degrees or programs
sponsored.sum: Relates to conditional release for eligible offenders who complete post-secondary degrees or programs; provides release twelve months before the completion of the controlling minimum period of imprisonment for eligible offenders who complete post-secondary degrees or programs.

sponsored.t: Relates to the publication of information on public meetings
sponsored.sum: Relates to the publication of information on public meetings; requires the office of information technology services to develop a mobile application and website to publish information on every public meeting held by a state or local public body; requires public bodies to report such meetings to the office of information technology services.

sponsored.t: Requires that all special education students attending schools scheduled to be closed or to undergo a significant change be assigned to new schools prior to the implementation of the closing or change
sponsored.sum: Requires that all special education students attending schools scheduled to be closed or to undergo a significant change be assigned to new schools prior to the implementation of the closing or change.

sponsored.t: Relates to banning the use of non-compostable produce stickers
sponsored.sum: Relates to banning the use of non-compostable produce stickers beginning January 1, 2026; provides civil penalties for violations; provides that fines shall be deposited into the environmental protection fund.

sponsored.t: Requires school districts to adopt a policy prohibiting the use of cellular telephones during classroom instruction
sponsored.sum: Requires school districts to adopt a policy prohibiting the use of cellular telephones during classroom instruction; requires the department of education to adopt a model policy for use by school districts.

sponsored.t: Relates to the use of single use plastic garment bags and dry cleaning bags
sponsored.sum: Prohibits dry cleaning establishments from returning clothing to customers in single use garment bags; allows dry cleaning establishments to return clothing to customers in reusable bags provided by such customers or offer for sale a reusable bag.

sponsored.t: Relates to the publication of notice of the death of an incarcerated individual or any other individual occurring in the custody of the department of corrections and community supervision
sponsored.sum: Provides notice of the death of an incarcerated individual occurring in the custody of the department of corrections and community supervision; requires the department to promptly notify the next kin and any other person designated as the representative of any incarcerated individual whose death takes place during custody.

sponsored.t: Prohibits early voting on federal holidays
sponsored.sum: Prohibits early voting on federal holidays; adds an additional day to the early voting period.

sponsored.t: Provides voice communication service to incarcerated people at no cost; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to providing voice communication services to incarcerated individuals in state correctional facilities at no cost.

sponsored.t: Allows certain reusable beverage containers in sports venues
sponsored.sum: Allows certain reusable beverage containers in sports venues.

sponsored.t: Enacts the state and local government food waste prevention and diversion act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the state and local government food waste prevention and diversion act; requires facilities generating excess food waste to take measures to minimize such waste.

sponsored.t: Expands eligibility for the tuition assistance program
sponsored.sum: Expands eligibility for the tuition assistance program by restoring eligibility to graduate students; makes optional semesters, quarters or terms eligible for awards.

sponsored.t: Provides representation to veterans for certain civil matters
sponsored.sum: Provides representation to veterans that are at or below four hundred percent of the federal poverty guidelines for matters involving children, sustenance and real property proceedings.

sponsored.t: Relates to permitting other qualifying members of a household to qualify for the disability rent increase exemption
sponsored.sum: Permits other qualifying members of a household to qualify the household for the disability rent increase exemption when they are not the head of household.

sponsored.t: Establishes state and municipal composting programs
sponsored.sum: Establishes state and municipal composting programs; requires all state and municipal agencies to establish a composting program in buildings owned, occupied or operated by such agencies; allows such agencies to arrange for collection of compostable waste by a private carter, transport such waste itself or process such waste on-site; requires reports on the costs and effectiveness of such programs.

sponsored.t: Requires consideration of union made commodities and services in the awarding of certain procurement contracts
sponsored.sum: Requires consideration as a quantitative factor whether the commodities or services were manufactured or will be performed by a labor union with respect to the awarding of certain procurement contracts.

sponsored.t: Relates to training for police officers before allowing them to carry or use a firearm
sponsored.sum: Relates to prohibiting police officers from carrying or using a firearm during any phase of the officer's official duties unless the officer has satisfactorily completed a course of training that meets or exceeds the minimum standards established by the municipal police training council.

sponsored.t: Establishes a reproductive health services training grant program
sponsored.sum: Establishes a reproductive health services training and education grant program to train licensed providers and interns or residents who are employed by a hospital or otherwise enrolled in an accredited graduate medical education program in the performance of abortion and related reproductive health services; establishes the reproductive health training and education fund.

sponsored.t: Establishes an office of sustainability
sponsored.sum: Establishes a chief sustainability officer to coordinate efforts across state agencies and other state government entities to address climate change mitigation and climate sustainability efforts.

sponsored.t: Relates to increasing fines for the late filing of rent registration statements
sponsored.sum: Increases fines for the late filing of rent registration statements; provides that a late filing fine shall be one thousand dollars.

sponsored.t: Provides for the conversion of condominium ownership for the preservation of expiring affordable housing in the city of New York
sponsored.sum: Relates to the conversion to condominium ownership for the preservation of expiring affordable housing in the city of New York; provides expanded homeownership opportunities from the conversion of certain residential rental buildings to condominium status by property owners that commit to preserve the inventory of expiring affordable housing in the city of New York.

sponsored.t: Provides for tuition assistance program awards for students experiencing homelessness
sponsored.sum: Expands tuition assistance program awards for students experiencing homelessness.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the use of aversive conditioning and other certain punishments
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the use of aversive conditioning which includes any procedure which causes obvious signs of physical pain, including but not limited to hitting, pinching and electric shock; prohibits the use of any procedure or punishment which denies a vulnerable person reasonable sleep, shelter, bedding, bathroom facilities and any other aspect expected of a humane existence; defines terms.

sponsored.t: Relates to employment of persons and veterans with disabilities by the state
sponsored.sum: Relates to employment of persons and veterans with disabilities by the state; provides up to five thousand positions may be filled by persons with a physical or mental disability and up to two thousand positions may be filled by disabled veterans and veterans with disabilities.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the inclusion of confidential clauses in contracts entered into for the purchase of services or commodities by the state
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the inclusion of confidential clauses in contracts entered into for the purchase of services or commodities by the state.

sponsored.t: Establishes standards for the design and construction of all-gender bathrooms
sponsored.sum: Establishes standards for the design and construction of all-gender bathrooms in the state and in New York city; provides standards will be permitted in both new construction and existing structures undergoing repair, renovation, or alteration work.

sponsored.t: Requires public elementary schools to start no earlier than eight a.m. and public secondary schools to start no earlier than eight thirty a.m.
sponsored.sum: Requires public elementary schools to start no earlier than eight a.m. and public secondary schools to start no earlier than eight thirty a.m.

sponsored.t: Implements a students' bill of rights for state university of New York and city university of New York institutions
sponsored.sum: Implements a students' bill of rights for city university of New York institutions to guarantee certain rights to students at such institutions.

sponsored.t: Requires bike shares to equip all bicycles with electric assist with speed and location tracking technology
sponsored.sum: Requires bike shares to equip all bicycles with electric assist with speed and location tracking technology and to revoke customer account if such customers ride over the speed limit or against the flow of traffic.

sponsored.t: Relates to enacting the central air conditioner and heat pump rights act
sponsored.sum: Relates to enacting the central air conditioner and heat pump rights act; provides that a homeowners' association may not adopt or enforce any rules or regulations that would effectively prohibit, or impose unreasonable limitations on, the installation or use of a central air conditioner or heat pump.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the New York city council to remove the mayor from office
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the New York city council to remove the mayor from office by a three-quarter majority vote.

sponsored.t: Directs state agencies to adopt an embodied carbon decarbonization program
sponsored.sum: Directs state agencies to adopt an embodied carbon decarbonization program; requires the office of general services to issue operational directives and guidance for common construction materials to reduce the amount of embodied carbon in such materials.

sponsored.t: Relates to an exemption from the licensing requirements for servicers of student loans
sponsored.sum: Relates to an exemption from the licensing requirements for servicers of student loans.

sponsored.t: Prohibits residential landlords from charging tenants a fee for a dishonored rent check in excess of the actual costs or fees incurred by such landlord as a result thereof
sponsored.sum: Prohibits residential landlords from charging tenants a fee for a dishonored rent check in excess of the actual costs or fees incurred by such landlord as a result thereof, provided such dishonored check fee was included in the initial lease.

sponsored.t: Directs state agencies to adopt a waste diversion plan
sponsored.sum: Directs state agencies to adopt a waste diversion plan.

sponsored.t: Provides for the adjustment of the minimum amount of tax delinquency for which the driver's license of a taxpayer may be suspended
sponsored.sum: Provides for the adjustment of the minimum amount of tax delinquency for which the driver's license of a taxpayer may be suspended, based on inflation; prohibits inclusion in the license suspension program of a taxpayer who receives public assistance or supplemental security income, or whose income does not exceed 250% of the poverty level; authorizes the commissioner to grant exemptions to taxpayers whose payment of past due tax liabilities would create a hardship to the taxpayer in meeting necessary living expenses.

sponsored.t: Relates to actions arising out of consumer debt
sponsored.sum: Relates to action arising out of consumer debt; defines consumer debt and replaces consumer credit transaction with such term.

sponsored.t: Ensures that the provisions governing liquor licenses are consistent with respect to public interest factors
sponsored.sum: Ensures that the provisions governing liquor licenses are consistent with respect to public interest factors.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring consumer reporting agencies contact consumers when requests are made for their consumer reports
sponsored.sum: Requires that consumer reporting agencies contact consumers when a request is made for their consumer reports; requires consumer reporting agencies to provide the consumer with information pertaining to the entity that requested the consumer report.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring gender neutral bathrooms in state-owned buildings
sponsored.sum: Relates to requiring gender neutral bathrooms in state-owned buildings; provides that if no single-occupancy bathroom can be designated as gender neutral in a state-owned building, a multiple-occupancy bathroom shall be designated as gender neutral instead; requires state-owned and state-leased buildings to provide adequate notice regarding gender neutral bathrooms.

sponsored.t: Relates to private education debt reporting
sponsored.sum: Provides that each student loan servicer shall submit an annual report containing a list of all private education creditors associated with the private education debts serviced by the student loan servicer that are owed by persons who resided in New York during the prior calendar year and containing additional information for each private education creditor reported.

sponsored.t: Relates to not including the process for declining designation to a county committee party position in the notice provided by the board of elections of the city of New York
sponsored.sum: Provides that the process for declining designation to a county committee party position does not need to be included in the notice provided by the board of elections of the city of New York of such party position designation.

sponsored.t: Relates to permitting the sale or distribution of expanded polystyrene containers that are designed or intended to be used for cold storage for certain purposes
sponsored.sum: Relates to permitting the sale or distribution of expanded polystyrene containers that are designed or intended to be used for cold storage for certain tissues, temperature sensitive health and safety samples, cultures, and reagents, and microbial cultures.
